verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets is documented as scanning code for exposed API keys, passwords and other credentials, and it validates whether found secrets are live and active. The pre-commit integration helps keep secrets out of Git history going forward. However, nothing in the evidence shows scanning of past commits or full git history, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented scanning of full git history and past commits, independent or hands-on corroboration of secret detection.
